title: Git Namespaces — Re-project Roles — payload
description: A community administrator, or a namespace admin, has the VTC send its bridge the complete forge roles of one repository, or of every repository in a namespace, again — so the forge comes to match the VTC's rights under the role map the bridge now applies. No right changes.

resource.description: A namespace (`<forge>/<owner>`): every active or orphaned repository in it. A repository (`<forge>/<owner>/<repo>`): that repository only.

reason.description: Why, in the caller's words. Kept with the audit record.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Re-project Roles — response payload
Response.description: The repositories the VTC queued a projectRoles job for.

repos.description: Each repository a projectRoles job was queued for, with its complete desiredRoles. Empty: the namespace has no active or orphaned repository.
